sources.title: qvac/TranscribePsy-250M-EU-sub · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: TranscribePsy-250M-EU-sub is a compact (254M-parameter) speech recognition model covering the eight European languages selected by Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS), distilled from Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3 and built for on-device and edge deployment. Concentrating the same parameter budget on fewer languages makes it the most accurate model in the TranscribePsy family on the languages it covers.

sources.title: GitHub - tether-ai-research/qvac-transcribepsy: State-of-the-art ...
sources.snippet: 📦 Models The model weights are released on the Hugging Face Hub: ... The on-device builds are TranscribePsy-250M-EU-sub. One set of weights covers all eight of its languages, so there is no language to set. Accuracy, architecture and training are described in the model cards.
